title: woodsia obtusa
intro: Woodsia obtusa, commonly known as the ladder fern or Japanese cliff fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Woodsiaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Woodsia obtusa include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which can help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Woodsia obtusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
